      "observations": [
        "All 270 owned diff lines across five paths are read. getAccountData now resolves the async stored SMTP password before building the account array. getQRCodes awaits Promise.all over accountKeys before chunking and JSON serialization. initializeQRCodes awaits those codes before resetting the step and showing the first image, and showCodes awaits initialization before inspecting step count or updating the visible step. The async API return annotations change to Promise types; valid cached passwords still short-circuit the storage lookup.",
        "The new unit task uses createMailAccount, which writes smtppass to Login Manager and the server cache. It clears outgoingServer.password only, awaits getAccountData, and directly asserts data[1][0][0][6] equals smtppass. This targets the stored-password fallback. Browser wizard tests await both production initialization and the expected generator; they also assert image data URI, progress localization metadata and navigation/step counts. They do not scan an image with Android or independently validate QR decoding. Changed assertion messages are nonempty and state the expected behavior.",
        "The existing password inclusion/authorization finding is reused. showCodes requests authorization before including passwords and returns if refused; a direct getAccountData call is not that UI boundary. The module leaves incoming-password handling guarded by passwordPromptRequired. Promise.all can overlap account lookups and rejects if a lookup rejects; no new cancellation, per-account recovery or UI error-handling guarantee follows. The current submit listener invokes showCodes without awaiting its returned promise.",
        "The fixed accepted module adds an enterprise-policy guard and an outgoing-server QueryInterface beyond this historical change. Existing public whole accepted module/caller/test objects retain their original IDs and times; their exact projection omits terminal LF, which is preserved rather than normalized. The SmtpServer snapshot is a safe shared window before an unrelated MOZ_SUITE marker at line 796; that optional branch is not read or copied.",
        "The exact complete primary original is reused with its original time and unknown original reader. Its description attributes the regression to the async SMTP lookup being serialized as an empty object; the owned awaited fallback, aggregation and direct stored-password assertion support the bounded source fix. Comments report Daily verification, no Beta verification, isolated risk, approval and later uplift; none is a new test or Android import by this study. Regressing1985223 and later2052173 remain bounded unread dependencies.",
        "The exact D309255 original retains its original creation/footer/zero-inline scope and unknown reader. B separately read the retained header/test plan to close the missing legacy scope, without a new page or replacing original flags. Listed commands, reported Android import and a request to check Try later are historical; no completed Try result is established. No discussion payload is copied into the source packet."
